items.prompt: Signal a counterpoint: '___, the risk profile has changed since our last discussion.'
Interrupt politely: '___, I would like to challenge one assumption in the proposal.'
Signal honesty: '___, the numbers do not support the optimism in this paper.'
items.hintAfterError: Expressão britânica formal de 3 palavras: 'In all' + substantivo que significa franqueza.

items.prompt: Disagree diplomatically: '___, that would be a difficult position to defend at board level.'
Concede, then redirect: '___, I believe there is a version of this that works for everyone.'
items.hintAfterError: A forma fixa usa o particípio: 'That' + particípio de 'say'.
